mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.member_id, s.target_id, s.customer_uid, s.price_id, s.status_id, s.next_billing_at, s.started_at, s.ended_at FROM subscription s JOIN common_code c ON s.status_id = c.id WHERE s.member_id = #{memberId} AND s.target_id = #{targetId} AND c.type = 4 AND c.code = 'SS01'

SELECT s.id AS subscriptionId, s.target_id AS targetId, m.nickname, m.profile_image AS profileImage, s.price_id AS priceId, s.next_billing_at AS nextBillingAt FROM subscription s JOIN member m ON s.target_id = m.id JOIN common_code c ON s.status_id = c.id WHERE s.member_id = #{memberId} AND c.type = 4 AND c.code = 'SS01' ORDER BY s.next_billing_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subscription ( member_id, target_id, customer_uid, price_id, status_id, next_billing_at, started_at, ended_at ) VALUES ( #{member_id}, #{target_id}, #{customer_uid}, #{price_id}, ( SELECT id FROM common_code WHERE type = 4 AND code = 'SS01' AND is_active = TRUE ), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), NOW(), NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE subscription SET next_billing_at = DATE_ADD(next_billing_at, INTERVAL 1 MONTH) WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND status_id = ( SELECT id FROM common_code WHERE type = 4 AND code = 'SS01' AND is_active = TRUE )

UPDATE subscription SET status_id = ( SELECT id FROM common_code WHERE type = 4 AND code = 'SS02' AND is_active = TRUE ), ended_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND target_id = #{targetId} AND status_id = ( SELECT id FROM common_code WHERE type = 4 AND code = 'SS01' AND is_active = TRUE )

UPDATE subscription SET status_id = ( SELECT id FROM common_code WHERE type = 4 AND code = 'SS03' AND is_active = TRUE ), ended_at = next_billing_at WHERE status_id = ( SELECT id FROM common_code WHERE type = 4 AND code = 'SS01' AND is_active = TRUE ) AND next_billing_at <= NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscription s JOIN common_code c ON s.status_id = c.id WHERE s.target_id = #{targetId} AND c.type = 4 AND c.code = 'SS01'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) FROM payment p WHERE p.payment_type = 'SUBSCRIPTION' AND p.target_id = #{targetId} AND p.status_id = 2 AND p.paid_at >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01') AND p.paid_at %lt; DATE_ADD( DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y-%m-01'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH )
